species.summary: Meranoplus bicolor, is a species of ant of the subfamily Myrmicinae. It is found in many Asian countries.

Percil gadjahmada (Microhyla gadjahmadai) adalah spesies katak dari genus Microhyla yang dilaporkan secara resmi pada tahun 2018. Meskipun telah tercatat ditemukan pada tahun 2010 di Lampung dan Bengkulu, tetapi katak ini baru sepenuhnya diidentifikasi pada tahun 2018.
Pseudodon vondembuschianus is a species of freshwater mussel from the family Unionidae. The species is endemic to Southeast Asia, present in both Mainland and Maritime nations of the region.

Parantica luzonensis, also commonly known as the Luzon glassy tiger, is a species of tiger butterfly that belongs to the family of brush-footed butterflies. This species has a wide range being found in Southeast Asia including Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippine Islands among other places.
Pirenella cingulata is a species of medium-sized sea snails or mud snails, marine gastropod mollusks in the family Potamididae, the horn snails.

Ranina ranina, also known as the (red) frog crab or spanner crab, is a species of crab found throughout tropical and subtropical habitats. It is often fished for its meat, and is the only known species in its genus.

Technomyrmex albipes, commonly known as the white-footed ant, is a species of ant first described in 1861 from Sulawesi, Indonesia by the British entomologist Frederick Smith. Invasive pest ants in Florida, previously identified as T.
Zemeros emesoides is a small butterfly that belongs to the Riodinidae family.

Atergatis floridus, the floral egg crab, green egg crab or shawl crab, is a species of tropical Indo-Pacific crab from the family Xanthidae. The meat of this crab is toxic, even if cooked, and consumption often results in death.
Cyclocheilos enoplos, also known as soldier-river barb or soldier river barb, is a species of ray-finned fish in the genus Cyclocheilos from south-east Asia and the Malay Archipelago.
Euploea eyndhovii, the striped black crow, is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Cajetan and Rudolf Felder in 1865. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Gasteracantha doriae adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1877 oleh Simon....
Hasora schoenherr, commonly known as the yellow banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India and Southeast Asia.
Hypolycaena thecloides, the brown tit, is a small but striking butterfly found in India and South-East Asia that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.

Iambrix stellifer, the starry bob or Malay chestnut bob, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in southern Burma, Laos, Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore, as well as on Borneo, Sumatra, Nias, Java, Batoe and Mentawi. The habitat consists of forested lowland areas.
Neptis omeroda is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia.
Odontolabis dalmani is a species of beetles belonging to the family Lucanidae.
Athyma reta, the Malay staff sergeant, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.

Pseudogobiopsis lumbantobing is a species of goby from the subfamily Gobionellinae which is found in Java and Sumatra where it occurs in freshwater rivers and streams at altitudes of 5–22 metres (16–72 ft), with substrates made up of sand, gravel, rock and boulders and where there may be growths of algae and aquatic ma…
Talthybia is a genus of Asian orb-weaver spiders containing the single species, Talthybia depressa. It was first described by Tamerlan Thorell in 1898, and has only been found in China and Myanmar.
Arcte modesta is a moth of the family Noctuidae.

Zeugodacus tau (syn. Bactrocera tau), the pumpkin fruit fly or the tau fruit fly, is a species of fruit fly in the family Tephritidae. The species is native to tropical and subtropical Asia. It is a major pest species of melons and other cucurbits.
Choaspes plateni, the branded awlking, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in Asia.

Cleora alienaria is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Francis Walker in 1860. It is found in Sri Lanka, the Indian subregion to the Andaman Islands, Thailand, Sundaland, Taiwan, and Lesser Sundas as far east as Timor and Christmas Island.

images.credit: Alan Kwok (King Lun), Ada Tai (Ah Heung) / 阿達蘭 AdAlan

species.summary: Eristalinus megacephalus is a species of hoverfly.
Idea lynceus, the tree-nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in South East Asia.
Monocerotesa proximesta is a moth of the family Geometridae first described by Jeremy Daniel Holloway in 1993. It is found in Borneo.
Mycalesis fuscum, the Malayan bush brown, is a butterfly of the Nymphalidae family. It is found on Peninsular Malaysia, Java, Borneo, and Nias.
Prosotas aluta, the banded lineblue, is a species of blue butterfly (Lycaenidae) found in Asia. The species was first described by Herbert Druce in 1873.
Tajuria mantra, the Felder's royal, is a butterfly in the Lycaenidae family. It is found in Asia.
Tetragonus lycaenoides is a moth of the family Callidulidae. It is found in Sulawesi, Borneo, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra and Nias.
Tosena fasciata is a cicada species from Southeast Asia that has been recorded from Sumatra, Java, Borneo and Ambon Island

Actinacantha is a genus of Southeast Asian orb-weaver spiders containing the single species, Actinacantha globulata. It was first described by Eugène Simon in 1864, and has only been found in Indonesia.
Amphidromus filozonatus is a species of medium-sized air-breathing tree snail, an arboreal gastropod mollusk in the family Camaenidae.
Appias indra, the plain puffin, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Southeast Asia.

Appias paulina, the common albatross, Christmas Island white or Ceylon lesser albatross, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found from India to Samoa, including Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, New Caledonia, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Australia.
Chikunia nigra, is a species of spider of the genus Chikunia. It is found in Sri Lanka to Taiwan, and Indonesia.
Chromodoris joshi is a species of sea slug. It is a dorid nudibranch, a shell-less marine gastropod mollusc in the family Chromodorididae.
Cirrochroa clagia is a species of butterfly of the family Nymphalidae which is found in Indonesia. It was described by Jean-Baptiste Godart in 1823.

Eudocima homaena is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found in the Indian subregion, Sri Lanka, Taiwan, Nicobars, Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, the Philippines and on Christmas Island. It is a major pest on orange plants.

Hippotion rafflesii, the Raffles' striated hawkmoth, is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Sri Lanka, southern and eastern India, Nepal, Myanmar, Thailand, southern China, Malaysia (Peninsular), Indonesia (Sumatra, Java, Sulawesi) and the Philippines.
Isometrus maculatus is a species of scorpion in the Buthidae family, commonly called in English the lesser brown scorpion. Its distribution is pantropical; it is an introduced species in Hawaii.
Lycaenopsis haraldus, Felder's Hedge Blue, is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1787. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Athyma kanwa, the dot-dash sergeant, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.
Pythia scarabaeus is a species of air-breathing saltmarsh snail, a pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Ellobiidae....
Sithon nedymond, the plush, is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by Hans Fruhstorfer in 1912. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Zythos strigata is a moth of the family Geometridae. It is found on Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Java, Bali and the Philippines (Palawan, Balabac Island).
Caplak kerbau (Amblyomma testudinarium) adalah sebuah spesies caplak berbadan keras dari genus Amblyomma. Spesies tersebut ditemukan di Indonesia, India, Jepang, Thailand, Sri Lanka dan Vietnam.
Amphidromus inversus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusk in the family Camaenidae.
Appias cardena, the yellow puffin, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1861. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Appias pandione is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Carl Geyer in 1832. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

species.name: Manyung pidada
species.summary: The spotted sea catfish (Arius maculatus), also known as the spotted catfish, the sea barbel or the marine catfish, is a species of sea catfish in the family Ariidae. It was described by Carl Peter Thunberg in 1792, originally under the genus Silurus.
Capila phanaeus, commonly known as the fulvous dawnfly, is a species of hesperid butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia.

images.credit: Frederic Moore (text); E. C. Knight / J N Fitch (art)

species.summary: Cerithidea obtusa is a species of sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Potamididae. The Obtuse Horn Shell, also known as Mud Creeper, is a relatively common snail found in muddy coastal areas. It grows to around 5–6 cm.
Discophora necho, the blue duffer, is a species of butterfly in the duffers group, that is, the Morphinae subfamily of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Euploea midamus, the blue spotted crow, is a butterfly found in India and South-East Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.

species.name: Kedukang
species.summary: Kedukang, kedukan, keropak, atau ikan duri (Hexanematichthys sagor) adalah sejenis ikan manyung yang biasa didapati di tepi pantai berlumpur dan kuala sungai.
Huechys sanguinea, commonly known as the black and scarlet cicada, is a species of cicada belonging to the family Cicadidae.
Melo melo, common name the Indian volute or bailer shell, is a very large sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusc in the family Volutidae, the volutes.
Micraspis discolor is a species of ladybird. It was described by Fabricius in 1798.
Naria gangranosa is a species of sea snail, a cowry, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Odontolabis castelnaudi is a beetle of the family Lucanidae.
Plastingia naga, the chequered lancer or silver-spot lancer, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae and sub-family Hesperiinae. It has a wingspan between 33–38 mm.
Tegillarca granosa (also known as Anadara granosa) is a species of ark clam known as the blood cockle or blood clam due to the red haemoglobin liquid inside the soft tissues.
Tetramorium bicarinatum, is a species of Formicidae family from the order Hymenoptera originated in South East Asia.
Tosena depicta is a cicada species from Southeast Asia...

The Asian monitor lizard tick, (Amblyomma varanense) is a hard-bodied tick of the genus Amblyomma. It is found in India, Thailand, Taiwan and Sri Lanka. Adults parasitize various reptiles such as varanids and snakes. These ticks are potential vectors of spotted fever group (SFG) rickettsiae.
Amphidromus djajasasmitai is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae....
Arhopala abseus, the aberrant oakblue or aberrant bushblue, is a species of lycaenid or blue butterfly found in Asia.
Bindahara phocides, the plane, is a small butterfly found Indomalayan (including India) and Australasian realms that belongs to the lycaenids or blues family.
Cepora julia is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found on Sumba and Sumbawa.
Cepora nadina, the lesser gull, is a small to medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is native to India, Myanmar, Hainan, and Southeast Asia.

Euploea alcathoe, commonly known as the no-brand crow, Eichhorn's crow or striped black crow, is a common butterfly found from India to Borneo, and in the Moluccas, New Guinea and Australia. It belongs to the crows and tigers subfamily of the Nymphalidae (brushfooted butterflies).

Heteropoda lunula is a large species of spider in the family Sparassidae. This species is found throughout South and Southeast asia, particularly from India to Vietnam, as well as in Malaysia and Indonesia. Heteropoda lunula is a popular huntsman spider in the pet trade.
Hexarthrius mandibularis is one of the world's largest stag beetle. It belongs to the tribe Lucanini, in the family Lucanidae.
Jamides abdul is a butterfly in the family Lycaenidae. It was described by William Lucas Distant in 1886. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Krananda semihyalina is a moth of the Geometridae family. It is found from the Oriental tropics to Japan, Sulawesi and the southern Moluccas.
Manto is a monotypic genus of butterflies in the family Lycaenidae. Its sole species, Manto hypoleuca, is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Mycalesis oroatis is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in South-east Asia.
Pantoporia paraka, the Perak lascar, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in tropical and subtropical Asia.
Pelopidas conjuncta, the conjoined swift, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Platerodrilus ngi is a species of net-winged beetle (Lycidae), which, as with other members of the genus, is considered a trilobite beetle.

Polyura delphis, the jewelled nawab, is a butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia that belongs to the rajahs and nawabs group, that is, the Charaxinae subfamily of the brush-footed butterflies family. This butterfly has multiple red spots bordered by yellow bands on a metallic white background.

Smithsonian Institution, National Museum of Natural History, Department of Entom

species.summary: Pomasia salutaris is a moth in the family Geometridae. It is found on Sumatra, Peninsular Malaysia and Borneo. The habitat consists of the upper montane zone up to altitudes of 2,110 meters.

Saletara liberia is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in Indonesia, the Philippines, Peninsular Malaysia and various islands in the region. Subspecies S. l. distanti is known by the common name Malaysian albatross.
Acropyga acutiventris is an ant in the subfamily Formicinae. It lives underground in tropical regions and forms a mutualistic association with the mealybug, Xenococcus annandalei.
Adrapsa geometroides is a moth of the family Noctuidae first described by Francis Walker in 1858. It is found in Indian subregion, Sri Lanka. to Sundaland and New Guinea.
Amphidromus sumatranus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae.

Argiope pulchella adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Argiope dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1881 oleh Thorell.

Choaspes subcaudata, commonly known as the blue awlking, is a species of butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is found in Asia, Malaysia and Borneo. The species was first described by Baron Cajetan von Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1867.
Euploea modesta is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1866. It is found in the Indomalayan realm and the Australasian realm.
Eurema lacteola, the scarce grass yellow, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India, Peninsular Malaya, Java, Sumatra and Borneo.
Euthalia alpheda is an Indomalayan butterfly of the Nymphalidae family (Limenitidinae).
Graphium ramaceus, the Pendlebury's zebra, is a species of butterfly in the family Papilionidae (swallowtails). It is found in parts of the Indomalaya ecozone.
Haemadipsa interrupta is a hermatophagous terrestrial leech found in the Malay Peninsula. It was described by John Percy Moore.

Pacet gunung (Haemadipsa zeylanica) (bahasa Inggris: mountain leech) adalah spesies pacet pengisap darah yang ditemukan di Asia Tenggara dan Asia Timur. Sub-spesies pacet ini juga ditemukan di area pegunungan di Jepang, Haemadipsa zeylanica japonica.
Hasora vitta, the plain banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India and parts of Southeast Asia.

Idea hypermnestra is a large butterfly that belongs to the danaid group of the family Nymphalidae. It was described by John Obadiah Westwood in 1848. It is found in the Indomalayan realm. It is found in Thailand and Malaysia.
Laringa castelnaui is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in Asia.
Lethe chandica, the angled red forester, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in the Indomalayan realm.
Nephrotoma australasiae the tiger crane fly is a species of flies in the family Tipulidae. It is found in Australia .

Notocrypta curvifascia, the restricted demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. N. curvifascia is commonly found in many regions of temperate and tropical East Asia, Indonesia, and the Indian subcontinent, wherever its preferred larval host plant, Alpinia nutans can be found.
Paratectonatica tigrina, common name tiger moon snail, is a species of predatory sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Naticidae, the moon snails.

Pelophryne ingeri is a species of toad in the family Bufonidae. It is found in the Peninsular Malaysia, Singapore, the Tioman Island (Malaysia), Sumatra (Indonesia), and possibly the Natuna and Mentawai Islands (Indonesia). In the past it has been confused with Pelophryne signata and P. brevipes.
Polyura jalysus is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by Cajetan Felder and Rudolf Felder in 1867. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Tetraponera allaborans, is a species of ant of the subfamily Myrmicinae, which can be found in many Asian countries.

Ugia disjungens is a species of moth in the Erebidae family. It is found in Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore and on Borneo. The habitat mostly consists of lowland forests, but specimens have been taken up to altitudes of 1,000 meters.

Ziridava xylinaria (indistinct carpet) is a moth in the family Geometridae. It is found in Sri Lanka, India, Hong Kong and on Peninsular Malaysia, Borneo, Java and possibly the Philippines and Sulawesi.
Aedes vexans, the inland floodwater mosquito, is a cosmopolitan and common pest mosquito.
Algia fasciata is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in Asia.

Ariadne merione, the common castor, is an orange butterfly with brown lines whose larvae feed almost exclusively on castor (Ricinus communis). It is similar in appearance to Ariadne ariadne, the angled castor.

species.name: Kekep Babi
species.summary: Kekep babi (bahasa Latin: Artamus leucorynchus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Artamidae, dari genus Artamus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan serangga kecil, kumbang, leba dan memiliki habitat di pesisir, sawah, kebun, tegalan, hutan sekunder. tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.
Bassarona dunya, the great marquis, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in South-East Asia.
Bibasis harisa, the orange awlet, is a species of hesperid found in Asia. The butterfly was reassigned to genus Burara by Vane-Wright and de Jong (2003) and is considered by them to be Burara harisa.
Charaxes distanti is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Eduard Honrath in 1885. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Culex sitiens is an insect native to coastal areas of East Africa and Madagascar, southwestern Asia, Ryukyu Archipelago, Korea, northern Australia and South Pacific islands.
Dasyboarmia subpilosa is a moth of the Geometridae family. It is found in India (NE Himalaya), Thailand, Peninsular Malaysia, Sumatra, Borneo, Philippines, Sulawesi and Buru.
Dophla evelina, the redspot duke, is a species of brush-footed butterfly found in South and Southeast Asia (Sri Lanka, Yunnan and India to the Philippines and Sulawesi). Many subspecies are accepted.
Elymnias penanga, the pointed palmfly, is a butterfly in the Nymphalidae family. It was described by John Obadiah Westwood in 1851. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.

Elysia ornata, commonly known as ornate elysia or ornate leaf slug, is a species of sea slug, a marine gastropod mollusk. This sea slug superficially resembles a nudibranch, yet it does not belong to that suborder of gastropods.

Eurema ada, the Talbot's Grass Yellow, is a species of butterfly in the genus Eurema. It was discovered in northern Borneo and described in 1871. Its main distinctive features are that its ground color is pale sulfurous, not white, and the border margins on its wings are blacker and wider. Wingspan is 35 mm.
Eusabena miltochristalis is a moth in the family Crambidae. It was first described in 1896 by George Hampson. It is found in north-eastern India, Myanmar and Taiwan.
Faunis gracilis is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Arthur Gardiner Butler in 1867. It is found in Sumatra and Malaya in the Indomalayan realm.
Hasora khoda, the large banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India, parts of Southeast Asia and Australia.
Mansonia (Mansonioides) uniformis is a species of zoophilic mosquito belonging to the genus Mansonia.
Megophrys lancip, the pointed horned frog, is a species of frog from the Megophrys genus. It is endemic to Indonesia. The species was scientifically described in 2018.

Moduza procris, the commander, sometimes included in the genus Limenitis, is a medium-sized, strikingly coloured brush-footed butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia. It is notable for the mode of concealment employed by its caterpillar and the cryptic camouflage of its pupa.
Neptis nata, the clear sailer or dirty sailer, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia.
Polyrhachis illaudata is a species of large ant found in Sri Lanka, India extending through Southeast Asia to the Philippines. The colonies have a single queen and nest within wood.
Polyrhachis tibialis is a species of ant in the subfamily Formicinae, found in many Asian countries. There are 10 subspecies recognized.
Pseudocoladenia dan, the fulvous pied flat, is an Indomalayan butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.

Strumigenys emmae is a species of ant in the genus Strumigenys. It is 1.5 millimeters long and is yellowish brown, has a 4 segmented antennae, small eyes, and has hairs on the head, mesosoma, and petiole that are mostly scale-like or orbicular.

Caplak sapi (Boophilus microplus atau Rhipicephalus microplus) adalah sejenis serangga yang menyerang sapi.Kerugian yang ditimbulkan umumnya karena menghisap darah menyebabkan anemia, merusak kulit, dermatitis.Namun perananya yang lebih penting adalah sebagai vektor penyakit piroplasmosis, anaplasmosis dan theileriosis…
The Indian threadfish (Alectis indica), also known as the Indian threadfin, diamond trevally, mirror fish or plumed trevally, is a large species of coastal marine fish of the jack family, Carangidae.
Technomyrmex horni is a species of Dolichoderine ant which is a widespread species that can be found in many Indo-Australian, Oriental, and Palaearctic regions.
Tetramorium pacificum, is a species of ant in the subfamily Myrmicinae. It is found in many countries.
Tetramorium simillimum, is a species of ant in the subfamily Myrmicinae. It is a small pale colored widespread species that can be found in almost all the continents.

The black-bellied hornet, or Vespa basalis, is a species of hornet native to Taiwan. It is one of the most dangerous species of hornet on the island, and its venom induces edema. Colonies may have as many as 5,000 individual hornets.

Xenocatantops humilis is the type species of grasshoppers in its genus of the family Acrididae and subfamily Catantopinae. This species can be found in India, Indo-China, Malesia (the type locality is Java), and Papua New Guinea.
Ypthima huebneri, the common fourring, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in Asia.
